notes.title: Dreams of Fear Demo Bug Fixes
notes.content: It was brought to my attention by a couple Dreams of Fear players that there were some issues with loading the game after dying and the demo giving players the proper ending. Thank you very much to those players who found and reported those issues! They should all be patched now and the demo should be bug free and ready to be played and enjoyed by all Dreams of Fear players. If there are ever issues in the future, please report them on the discussion board and I'll do my best to track them down and squash them like the bugs they are! Thank you everyone for playing Dreams of Fear! You guys make development worth it!
